checks.detail: The connected milestone remains incomplete. Reachable startup and source paths provide unarmed traversal and controls, but no ordinary acquisition, training victory/reward, death recovery, lamp/upgrade or pause/save/restart route. The mandatory closure recipe cannot execute. Separately, current screenshots expose default demo key/status cards, and candidate-scoped editor logs report the missing grass PSD dependency. These observed presentation/import violations fail the criterion. Implemented controls interruption and recovery showed no runtime errors or stale actions. Selected village/actor resource bytes remain preserved. Unknown-surface patrol covered pointer selection during capture and opening controls during Roll; no durable defect was observed. Unchanged graphics/skin toggles were lower priority and skipped. Reference comparison confirms adult scale and readable third-person framing; the snowy, strongly contrasted village differs from the warm reference direction. Exactly one next-phase boundary was inspected: opening cinematic continuity remains absent. No relevant tester_* setup actions were disclosed in source or the live InputMap. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.ab52206012fd=insufficient_evidence; coverage.required_criteria.dfbc8f7e701c=fail; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.f59fe1852eab=pass; coverage.baseline.exploratory_review.f5cb3a11443d=fail; coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=fail; coverage.baseline.visual_reference_alignment.e080828a7b5e=pass;

Both selected task conditions passed independently. External logical-key inputs demonstrated B/F ownership, B-to-U-to-default rebinding, actual Roll playback, forward displacement and recovery. Tab twice preserved actor/camera world orientation while shoulder_blend interpolated; E did not switch shoulders. WASD, Shift sprint, Space jump/landing, Alt dodge, unarmed equipment gates and mouse-look release/recovery responded correctly. Capture cancellation and held W across dismissal produced no movement, Roll, shoulder change or attack; fresh W subsequently moved. The Developer risk was resolved for these local conditions through native input, controls screenshots, live InputMap, traversal and AnimationPlayer observations. Full R02 remains blocked: automatic stepping and earned hand/back equipment states were not independently demonstrated, and the acquisition route is unavailable. Runtime camera coverage measured the visible actor; custom views inspected head and ground contact. The editor-only dynamic wrapper has no static geometry, so its NO_GEOMETRY bounds receipt is not a product defect. required_criteria.requirement:
Review the declared production milestone 基础空间与可玩切片。: **基础空间与可玩切片。** 先在 MAP01 的紧凑真实空间完成移动/镜头、伊莎求助、交剑、一次可胜利且可死亡恢复的训练实战；随后连接弓、旧灯、首次升级、主题化界面、暂停存档与重载，组成约 5–8 分钟的连续可玩切片。MAP02/MAP03 此时只核查候选素材、通路与战场容量，不以独立空地图作为本阶段交付；先验证角色动作、真实战斗、任务变化和保存能共同运作，再复制内容。
Require candidate-bound runtime evidence for this milestone; future milestones remain pending, and previously verified behavior must be preserved. This milestone review does not waive any final PRD requirement.

PRD R02: 移动、跳跃、冲刺、闪避、自动上阶与镜头有效；朝向、手持、背挂和切肩正确
Bind candidate runtime evidence to scenario(s): review_r02. This is a required product acceptance review, not an executable test or a passed observation.

developer_outcome.summary: Developer observed external rebinding, matching prompts/InputMap, Roll playback, displacement and recovery using current runtime identities. The cited receipt establishes boundary identity only. Required independent Host/Tester pairing and formal acceptance remain unperformed.

risk_note.summary: Ordinary rebinding and short Roll transitions may remain insufficiently evidenced if the registered capture path cannot operate the controls surface or sample authoritative intermediate state.
risk_note.validation: Host and Tester must pair external input and controls screenshots with actual effective bindings, traversal action, animation playback and recovery observations. Resolve runtime node paths in the current session; do not assume the historical generated traversal-node name is stable.
risk_note.why_now: The major input issue has persisted across two findings, and another source-only key patch would leave its configurable-control acceptance unresolved.

task_requirements.requirement: During grounded unarmed exploration with default bindings, one B press starts Roll with advancing playback and movement consistent with the visible facing or movement direction, then returns to controllable idle or walking; F never starts Roll.
Using ordinary in-game controls, the player rebinds Roll from B to an unused U key: the prompt updates, U starts Roll and B no longer does; restoring defaults restores the B prompt and behavior.
